mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activities (category_id, name, description, address, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{address}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.category_id, a.name, a.description, a.address, a.status, a.created_by, a.created_at, a.updated_at, c.name AS category_name FROM activities a LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = a.category_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE activities SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.category_id, a.name, a.description, a.address, a.status, a.created_by, a.created_at, a.updated_at, c.name AS category_name FROM activities a LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = a.category_id
ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
